changes_made.explanation: Removed FedAvg, FedOPT, and FedProx from models since these are federated learning algorithms, not NLG models. The actual generation model is T5-base. Normalized task naming convention.
Normalized 'Exact Match (EM)' to 'Exact Match' for consistency. Kept MacroAvg and MicroAvg as they are defined metrics used for evaluation.
No LLM-based evaluation was conducted in this paper. The paper evaluates generated SQL queries using exact string matching metrics.
The paper does not conduct any human evaluation of the generated outputs.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on federated learning for semantic parsing (text-to-SQL generation). The main NLG task is converting natural language questions to SQL queries. Evaluation is fully automatic using exact match metrics. The paper introduces a novel re-weighting mechanism (Lorar) for federated learning algorithms but does not involve human or LLM-based evaluation of the generated SQL queries.
